sentence: This project builds software tools that can be added to existing databases so artificial intelligence tasks run faster.
This project tries to separate ecosystem carbon and water fluxes into their component fluxes using remote sensing of chlorophyll fluorescence.
This project explores robotics, automation, and additive manufacturing methods such as binder jetting and aerosol jet printing.
This project operates an array of telescopes to study very high energy gamma rays from galactic and extragalactic sources and tests a prototype telescope.
This project builds and tests a model of how uncertain judgments settle into stable decisions, using tools from quantum theory.
This project studies a spin transistor that uses screw dislocations, a type of crystal defect, in semiconductors as its channel.
This project brings scientists together to discuss how AI and cyberinfrastructure can support ecological research.
This project builds online materials and interactive software that introduce quantum computing and quantum machine learning.
This project works to solve the discrete uniformization problem for all polyhedral surfaces by developing mathematical structures and algorithms.
This project studies how plasmas and rotating fluids behave, using partial differential equations inspired by physics.
This project builds a data tool that combines on-the-ground measurements, satellite data, and mathematical models to understand how carbon moves through ecosystems.
This project designs efficient algorithms and computation systems for graph neural networks on both static and dynamic graphs.
This project tries to find out how communities that consume toothed whales can adapt as climate change shifts marine resources.
This project secures instruments such as an atomic force microscope, optical tweezers, and a Raman spectrometer for biophysics.
This project develops a mathematical framework for training generative adversarial networks to create synthetic data, and addresses mode collapse.
This project develops a method that uses ultraviolet irradiation and a catalyst to degrade polyfluoroalkyl substances in water.
